name: eunomia-treasury
summary: Pick up and spend from a bounded Eunomia treasury on Stellar mainnet via eunomia-mcp — on-chain policy enforcement, x402/MPP paid API float, signed task-budget links, and on-chain exception requests.

env.name: EUNOMIA_RPC_URL
env.description: HTTPS Stellar mainnet Soroban RPC endpoint

env.name: EUNOMIA_HOME
env.description: Directory for local Leash credentials and payee cache (defaults to ~/.eunomia)
